# Source: Design cover for West Point Song of the Graduates

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Design cover for West Point Song of the Graduates
- **Artist / culture:** James McNeill Whistler American, 1834-1903
- **Date:** 1852
- **Style:** Unspecified
- **Classification:** transfer lithograph
- **Department:** Prints and Drawings
- **AIC artwork ID:** 14482
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/14482
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/c52ac8f4-fef0-bce3-55e9-63432fe8125e/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Book and Cover

## Extracted source palette

`#F8E8D8, #D8D8C8, #C8B8B8, #A8A898, #988888, #787868, #F8D8B8, #585858`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#FCF5EF`
- `surface`: `#FEFCF9`
- `on_surface`: `#0F0F11`
- `primary`: `#988888`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#F8D8B8`
- `surface_variant`: `#E0D9D4`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#0F0F11`
- `outline`: `#BAB5B1`
- `error`: `#988888`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `serif` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `6dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `17.73:1`, surface `18.7:1`
- Variant contrast: `13.72:1`
- Control contrast: `5.78:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
